LogisticRegression.preprocessing: StandardScaler fit on training rows only

decision_rules.return: A learned option may advance over momentum only with a positive mean primary difference and improvement in at least three of four folds. Otherwise retain momentum.
decision_rules.risk: A learned option may advance over trailing volatility only with a positive mean macro-F1 difference, improvement in at least three of four folds, non-worse mean High-risk recall, and no increase in total High-to-Low errors.

phase8_gate: Freeze the selected procedure before inspecting a genuinely later verified period. The reused 2024-2025 period is not a blind test.
